intro: As you sing higher, there's a spot where your voice wants to crack or shift, like switching gears. That's your voice break. The piano plays notes going up, one every two seconds. Sing along, and press the button when you feel the shift.
voiceHint: This sets where the piano starts and which voice types your break is compared with.
climbHelp: Sing along with each note. When your voice wants to crack, flips to a lighter sound, or you have to push harder, press the button.
climbTop: That was the top of the search. If you felt the shift on the last notes, press the button. If not, try again.
confirmHelp: You heard a note a little below it, the note itself, and one a little above. Move it until it sits where the shift happened.
zone: Keyboard with your first shift at {primo} and the estimated second at {secondo}
announce: Your voice break is around {note}, closest to {voiceType}.
voiceBreakEducational: Voice type also depends on where your voice sounds best and your tone quality.
averages: The match uses classical averages for each voice type. Voices vary, and where you shift can move with warmup and training.
saved: Kept in this browser, so the warm-up piano can build its exercises around it.
noAudio: This browser can't play audio. Try a recent Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge.
loadFailed: The piano didn't load. Check your connection and try again.
